floor_cell.rationale: No in-force sovereign or general-food iAs maximum level applies to this product on the dietary-content basis after the supersession of regulations/israel-moh-fcs-2016-heavy-metals-tin-food-guidelines; the species is bounded by its parent total (tAs) per the certification-readiness ruling (species ≤ total).

iAs.rationale: Published iAs of 60 ug/kg is retained as a precautionary program value after the instrument that carried it (il_fcs2016_ias_3_fruits_and_vegetables_including_mushrooms_edible_pla_60) was superseded; the strictest in-force sovereign floor is the parent total that bounds iAs. HMTc is a ratcheting program and does not loosen a live limit because an instrument died.
iAs.label: Precautionary: 60 ug/kg, below the sovereign floor of 300 ug/kg (mercosur_gmc12_2011_agaricus_pleurotus_lentinula_lentinus_mushrooms_tas_300). The floor is the strictest in-force government maximum level; the program number is a disclosed policy choice, not a claim about the law.

Ni.label: Surveillance read-across (not a fungi government limit): no credible sovereign sets a nickel maximum level for edible fungi in any jurisdiction — the EU 2024/1987 nickel regulation enumerates tree nuts, vegetables (incl. herbs/seaweed), legumes, oilseeds, cocoa, baby food, and juices but deliberately does not list fungi. HMTc nonetheless publishes a documented nickel surveillance ceiling by disclosed read-across from the nearest applicable sovereign value, the EU 2024/1987 fruiting-vegetable nickel ML (400 ug/kg, wet weight), rather than leaving nickel with no numeric ceiling. This is a surveillance value on the honest read-across basis, not a claimed sovereign fungi limit.
Ni.basis_note: face value (nearest sovereign value; comparator vs any direct limit)

lineage: Cat-29 government-limit-default compile (HMTc Method v2.0). Anchors: EU Reg. 2023/915 (wild fungi Pb 800 / Cd 500; cultivated fungi Pb 300 / Cd 50; oyster+shiitake Cd 150), Switzerland VHK 2026 (wilde Pilze Pb 800 / Cd 500; Agaricus bisporus Cd 50), MERCOSUR GMC 12/2011 and Paraguay Decreto 1335/2019 (Agaricus/Pleurotus/Lentinula tAs 300), Israel FCS-2016 (fruits and vegetables including mushrooms: tHg 30 / iAs 60 / tAs 1000). Cultivated-cadmium split (common Cd 50 vs oyster/shiitake Cd 150 → cultivated-mushrooms-oyster-shiitake) ratified 2026-08-13 per OI-20260813-cultivated-mushroom-cd-split.
